# MCP tools catalog

<!-- Generated by `python -m softone_mcp.catalog`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool returns the same envelope:

- Success: `{"ok": true, "data": ..., "meta": {"trace_id", "tool", "actions"}}`
- Error: `{"ok": false, "error": {"code", "message", "details"}, "meta": {...}}`

Call `softone_connect_default` first and pass its `session_id` to every other tool.

### `softone_connect_default`

Connect using .env (SOFTONE_*) and return a session_id (auto-picks first COMPANY/BRANCH/MODULE/REFID).

### `get_context`

Return the session selection context (company/branch/module/refid) for a given session_id.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes |  |

### `create_customer`

Business action: create a customer.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Customer name. |
| `code` | `string` |  | Customer code. Leave empty to auto-generate. |
| `afm` | `string` |  | Tax id (AFM). Leave empty to omit. |
| `email` | `string` |  | Email. Leave empty to omit. |
| `phone` | `string` |  | Phone. Leave empty to omit. |
| `address` | `string` |  | Address. Leave empty to omit. |
| `balance` | `string` |  | Opening balance. Leave empty to omit. |
| `created_at` | `string` |  | Optional created_at ISO string. Leave empty to omit. |

### `get_customer`

Business action: get a customer by id or name/code (mock supports name/code lookup).

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `name_or_id` | `string` | yes | Customer id or name/code (mock supports name/code lookup). |
| `locateinfo` | `string` |  | Optional locateinfo projection string (advanced). |

### `update_customer`

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `name_or_id` | `string` | yes | Customer id or name/code (mock supports name/code lookup). |
| `code` | `string` |  | New code. Leave empty to skip. |
| `name` | `string` |  | New name. Leave empty to skip. |
| `email` | `string` |  | New email. Leave empty to skip. |
| `phone` | `string` |  | New phone. Leave empty to skip. |
| `afm` | `string` |  | New tax id (AFM). Leave empty to skip. |
| `address` | `string` |  | New address. Leave empty to skip. |
| `balance` | `string` |  | New balance. Leave empty to skip. |
| `created_at` | `string` |  | New created_at. Leave empty to skip. |

### `inventory_adjustment`

Adjust stock for an item by delta_qty (integer). Guarded: cannot make stock negative or below reserved.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `name_or_id` | `string` | yes | Item id or name/code (mock supports name/code lookup). |
| `delta_qty` | `string` | yes | Signed integer delta, e.g. '-2' or '5'. |
| `reason` | `string` |  | Optional reason (informational only in MVP). |

### `create_order`

Create a new sales order for a customer. Validates customer and stock, reserves inventory, calculates total. Returns order with status 'Draft' or 'Confirmed' (auto-approved if total < threshold).

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `customer_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the customer placing the order |
| `items` | `list[OrderLineInput]` | yes | List of items and quantities |
| `notes` | `string` |  | Optional order notes |

### `workflow_create_order`

Deterministic workflow: resolve customer/items, validate stock, reserve inventory, create order, and (optionally) auto-approve based on policy. This is the preferred tool for 'place an order' intents.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `customer` | `string` | yes | Customer id or name/code (mock supports name/code lookup). |
| `items` | `list[WorkflowOrderLineInput]` | yes | List of items and quantities (item id or name/code). |
| `notes` | `string` |  | Optional order notes |
| `auto_approve` | `string` |  | Auto-approve policy: never | if_under_threshold | always. |

### `approve_order`

Approve a Draft order, moving it to Confirmed status. Once confirmed, an invoice can be generated. Raises an error if the order is not in Draft status.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `order_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the Draft order to approve |

### `get_order`

Fetch a sales order by ID.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `order_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the order to fetch |

### `get_order_lines`

Fetch line items for a sales order by order_id. Each line includes item_id, quantity, and unit_price.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `order_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the order whose lines to fetch |

### `list_orders`

List orders (mock-only). Optional filters: customer_id, status. Use this for visibility/debugging and to discover existing orders.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `customer_id` | `string` |  | Filter by customer ID. Leave empty for all customers. |
| `status` | `string` |  | Filter by status (e.g. 'Draft', 'Confirmed'). Leave empty for all. |
| `limit` | `string` |  | Max rows to return. Leave empty for default. |

### `cancel_order`

Cancel a Draft order. MVP semantics: cancellation deletes the order. Confirmed orders cannot be cancelled in this MVP.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `order_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the Draft order to cancel. |
| `reason` | `string` |  | Optional cancellation reason (informational only in MVP). |

### `update_order`

Update a Draft order header (Draft-only). Use this for notes or other small header changes. Raises an error if the order is not Draft.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `order_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the Draft order to update |
| `notes` | `string` |  | New notes (replaces existing notes). |

### `add_order_line`

Add (or merge) a line onto a Draft order (Draft-only). Reserves inventory for the added quantity and updates order total.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `order_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the Draft order to modify |
| `item_id` | `integer` | yes | Item ID to add |
| `quantity` | `integer` | yes | Quantity to add (must be > 0) |

### `remove_order_line`

Remove all lines for an item from a Draft order (Draft-only). Releases the reserved quantity for that item and updates order total.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `order_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the Draft order to modify |
| `item_id` | `integer` | yes | Item ID to remove from the order |

### `search_customers`

Search customers by name/code/AFM (mock-only). Returns a list of matches with ids you can use in create_order.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `q` | `string` | yes | Search query (name/code/AFM substring). |
| `limit` | `string` |  | Max rows to return. Leave empty for default. |

### `create_invoice`

Generate an invoice from a Confirmed order. Calculates due date from payment terms, deducts stock from inventory. The order must be in Confirmed status — use approve_order first if needed.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `order_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of a Confirmed order to invoice |
| `payment_terms` | `string` |  | Payment terms: 'due_on_receipt', 'net_30', 'net_60', 'net_90' |

### `workflow_order_to_cash`

Workflow: create order (with reservations) and then create an invoice if the resulting order is Confirmed. This workflow will NOT auto-approve Draft orders during invoicing; use auto_approve on the order step or call approve_order explicitly.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `customer` | `string` | yes | Customer id or name/code (mock supports name/code lookup). |
| `items` | `list[object]` | yes | Order lines: [{"item_name_or_id": str, "quantity": int}, ...]. |
| `notes` | `string` |  | Optional order notes |
| `auto_approve` | `string` |  | Auto-approve policy for the order step: never | if_under_threshold | always. |
| `payment_terms` | `string` |  | Payment terms for invoicing: due_on_receipt | net_30 | net_60 | net_90. |

### `get_unpaid_invoices`

Fetch all unpaid invoices. Optionally filter by customer_id for a per-customer collections view.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `customer_id` | `string` |  | Filter by customer ID. Leave empty to get all unpaid invoices. |

### `get_invoice`

Fetch a single invoice by ID.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `invoice_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the invoice to fetch |

### `list_invoices`

List invoices (mock-only). Optional filters: status, customer_id. Use this for visibility and collections workflows.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `status` | `string` |  | Filter by status (unpaid|partial|paid). Leave empty for all. |
| `customer_id` | `string` |  | Filter by customer ID. Leave empty for all customers. |

### `record_payment`

Record a payment against an invoice. In the mock backend, the invoice status is automatically refreshed (unpaid → partial → paid) based on the sum of payments.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `invoice_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the invoice being paid. |
| `amount` | `string` | yes | Payment amount (e.g. '100.00'). Parsed as a float. |
| `payment_date` | `string` |  | Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to default to now. |

### `list_invoice_payments`

List all payments recorded against an invoice. Returns id, invoice_id, amount, and payment_date for each row.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `invoice_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the invoice whose payments to list. |

### `get_payment`

Fetch a single payment by ID.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `payment_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the payment to fetch. |

### `refund_payment`

Refund (delete) a payment by ID. In the mock backend, the associated invoice status is rolled back (paid → partial → unpaid) as the sum of payments drops.

| Param | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `string` | yes | Session obtained from softone_connect_default(). |
| `payment_id` | `integer` | yes | ID of the payment to refund (delete). |
